science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
text: [DUSK_CRAFT at The_Ferrofluid_Coast] The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear ripped across the black ferrofluid sea, pulling the magnetic ocean into towering, jagged spikes that caught the dying light of the twin suns. The booming crash of the heavy liquid echoed against the basalt cliffs, carrying the sharp scent of ozone and a faint taste of metallic salt on the freezing wind. Kaio stood on the precipice, bracing his scout rig to DEFEND against the violent magnetic undertow dragging at his boots. He adjusted his localized field emitters to CONSUME the raw static charge from the air, channeling the energy to CONCEAL his signature from the dangerous resonance squalls sweeping the coast. Skating back from the edge with the vital telemetry cylinder still glowing hot in his grip, he burst through the heavy airlock doors of the Hub and shoved the physical baton straight into Ryn's flour-dusted hands.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Gather exterior telemetry from the ferrofluid sea and deliver it to the Hub
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the Enclave against the rising ferrofluid sea
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Maintain structural stability during the impending suns' polarity inversion

active_location.macro_silhouette: A jagged basalt coastline overlooking an undulating ocean of pitch-black magnetic liquid. The shore is constantly reshaped by intense magnetic shear forces that pull the sea into towering spikes. The atmosphere here is violent, cold, and charged with static.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Pitch-black fluid spikes catching the dying light
sensory_palette.sound: Booming crash of heavy liquid and roaring wind
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Freezing wind with dragging magnetic pull

interactive_features.affordance_description: A powerful dragging force that threatens to pull unanchored gear into the sea.
Environmental static that can be harvested to power personal rig shields.
Dangerous waves of magnetic interference that can scramble telemetry.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Disrupt electronic shielding and scramble unshielded data cores.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Sweeping across the coast driven by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The squall is directly intercepting the path back to the Hub airlock.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will completely wipe the telemetry data from the brass cylinder before Kaio reaches safety.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio must navigate the shear squalls without losing the telemetry data.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Ryn needs the telemetry cylinder to calibrate the metabolic engine's power draw against the incoming storm.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering the volatile ferrofluid environment is critical for the colony's long-term survival.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Kaio's shielding falters, allowing the squall to partially corrupt the telemetry data and forcing a harsher power cycle.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: You misjudge the magnetic undertow, slipping and exposing the cylinder entirely; the data is completely wiped.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: You make it through, but the squall grazes the cylinder; the data is fragmented and Ryn will have to improvise.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: You deftly maneuver through the squall, delivering the pristine telemetry data straight to Ryn.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: You perfectly ride the magnetic currents, supercharging the cylinder and delivering it with excess stored power.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Ryn blinks through the flour dust as the heavy, glowing cylinder is thrust into their hands. What does Ryn do?
